about: 수령수표조회 [선택삭제] — 받은수표를 받고 입금한 뒤(API), 감소 줄을 지우면 보유로 돌아오고 입금 분개 · 계좌 입금이 되돌아가며, 증가 줄을 지우면 수표가 사라진다. 입금까지 한 수표의 증가 줄만 지워도 막지 않고(원본과 같다) 감소를 먼저 취소해 계좌가 돌아온다. [최종수정자] 조건이 있다.

shots.name: 준비 — 받은수표 1장 받고 오늘 입금(API), 계좌 잔액을 적어 둔다
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async()=>{const today=new Date(Date.now() + 9 * 36e5).toISOString().slice(0, 10);const p=(await window.__api('GET','/partners')).body.find((x)=>x.code==='QA-CUST');const acc=(await window.__api('GET','/bank-cards/accounts')).body.find((a)=>a.active!==false);const no='QADEL-'+Date.now();const c=await window.__api('POST','/checks',{type:'RECEIVED',checkNo:no,amount:23456,issueDate:today,partnerId:p.id,remark:'QA회계2 수표삭제'});const before=(await window.__api('GET','/bank-cards/accounts')).body.find((a)=>a.id===acc.id).balance;const dep=await window.__api('POST','/checks/'+c.body.id+'/deposit',{bankAccountId:acc.id,depositDate:today});sessionStorage.setItem('ckNo',no);sessionStorage.setItem('ckId',c.body.id);sessionStorage.setItem('accId',acc.id);sessionStorage.setItem('bal',before);return c.status+'/'+dep.status})()

js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

shots.name: 입금한 수표의 증가 줄만 지워도 막지 않는다 — 수표가 사라지고 계좌 잔액이 입금 전으로
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async()=>{const today=new Date(Date.now() + 9 * 36e5).toISOString().slice(0, 10);const p=(await window.__api('GET','/partners')).body.find((x)=>x.code==='QA-CUST');const accId=sessionStorage.getItem('accId');const no='QADEL2-'+Date.now();const c=await window.__api('POST','/checks',{type:'RECEIVED',checkNo:no,amount:11111,issueDate:today,partnerId:p.id,remark:'QA회계2 수표삭제'});const before=(await window.__api('GET','/bank-cards/accounts')).body.find((a)=>String(a.id)===accId).balance;await window.__api('POST','/checks/'+c.body.id+'/deposit',{bankAccountId:Number(accId),depositDate:today});sessionStorage.setItem('ck2No',no);sessionStorage.setItem('ck2Id',c.body.id);sessionStorage.setItem('bal2',before);return c.status})()
